data.gender_notes: Lakum is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lakum is a Sanskrit name that means 'Lord of Fortune'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lakshmi', which is the Hindu goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. The name Lakum signifies the one who is blessed with divine grace and prosperity. The name Lakum carries the meaning “Lord of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Lakum usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lakum is a spiritual name that represents the divine energy of abundance and prosperity. It is believed that the name Lakum is blessed by the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, who is the embodiment of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. This name is often used in Hindu rituals and ceremonies to invoke the blessings of the goddess Lakshmi.
data.etymology: Lakum belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lakum total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

By giving their child the name Lakum, Hindu parents aspire for their child's future to be filled with success, good fortune, and prosperity.
